run_process_all_files: run the script to update copyright headers and include guards across all source files in the repository
run_verify_test_consistency: run a check that unit and integration test source files are listed in both Jamfile and CMakeLists.txt
create_gen_header: create a copyright header block with configurable comment symbols, shebang lines, and include guards
create_processor_for_file_type: create a file processor like HppProcessor or XmlProcessor to handle header insertion for a specific file extension
run_process_single_file: run the file processor on a single source file to update its copyright header and include guard
